<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Glorio''' is the warrior who tests you in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]]. In [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]], the raid of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]], he fights on [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]]'s side as the boss of the fourth wave. He has the widest set of moves of the raid's three bosses.
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Glorio is the boss of wave 4, together with 10 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah Soldier|Gomah Soldiers]]. He stays dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking him wakes him up early. Like every raid boss, he glows red.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid he has 450,000 health, 19,000 melee damage and 17,000 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Elite]] AI tier. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Glorio flies and follows you into the air.
* '''Ki attacks:''' lilac '''Ki Blast''', '''Ki Volley''' (a spray of small blasts), '''Ki Wave''' and '''Dodon Ray''' (a fast ki ray).
* '''Melee Combo:''' he teleports around you, striking from the front and from behind, and ends with a heavy blow.
* '''Aerial Combo:''' he knocks you into the air, appears above you and slams you back down.
* '''Rapid Kicks:''' he teleports in front of you and kicks you in a rapid flurry.
* '''Zanzoken:''' he can vanish out of the way of an attack, leaving an afterimage (2 hops).
* '''Dodging:''' he can step back out of the way of your hits, with the shortest cooldown of any raid boss.
* '''Teleporting:''' he teleports to you when you keep your distance or charge an attack from range.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Glorio drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army#Rewards|Gomah's Army]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], the quest '''Glorio's Test''' has you spar with him on the Third Demon World.
</translate>
